select la.id, la.phone, la.name, la.identification_number, la.lease_start_date, la.lease_end_date, la.rent, la.deposit, la.status, la.source_type, la.additional_info, ai.id apartment_id, ai.name apartment_name, ai.district_id, ai.district_name, ai.city_id, ai.city_name, ai.province_id, ai.province_name, ri.id room_id, ri.room_number, lt.id lease_term_id, lt.month_count, lt.unit, pt.id payment_type_id, pt.name payment_type_name, pt.pay_month_count from lease.lease_agreement la left join lease.apartment_info ai on ai.id = la.apartment_id and ai.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.room_info ri on ri.id = la.room_id and ri.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.lease_term lt on lt.id = la.lease_term_id and lt.is_deleted = 0 left join lease.payment_type pt on pt.id = la.payment_type_id and pt.is_deleted = 0
la.is_deleted=0 and ai.province_id=#{queryVo.provinceId} and ai.city_id=#{queryVo.cityId} and ai.district_id=#{queryVo.districtId} and ai.id=#{queryVo.apartmentId}
and ri.room_number like concat('%',#{queryVo.roomNumber},'%')
and la.name like concat('%',#{queryVo.name},'%')
and la.phone like concat('%',#{queryVo.phone},'%')
